title: Choose the feel of your home workout app
question: Every option below is built around solo exercise at home. Each makes Today’s workout the first thing you see, then guides the session with large one-handed controls.

options.label: Resistance Band Flow
options.lineage: resistance bands, woven straps, cork blocks, and printed exercise mats
options.thesis: The whole program behaves like a set of elastic training bands: Today pulls forward, progress stays connected, and finished work relaxes behind you.
options.viewport: Home opens on one large Today panel with Week, Workout, duration, and Start; a colored band underneath shows where this session sits in the 12-week plan.
options.risk: The band motif must remain functional progress and motion, never decorative squiggles.

options.label: Home Coach
options.lineage: a calm personal coach, a clear session card, and a thumb-reachable Android app
options.thesis: One friendly card tells you exactly what to do now; everything else stays quiet until you ask for it.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and maximizes product clarity, but feels less ownable than the gear-native Resistance Band Flow.
options.viewport: Today’s workout fills the upper half with one Begin button; recent progress and the 12-week plan sit below in a simple, reachable stack.
options.risk: Without disciplined hierarchy it can become another generic card dashboard.

options.label: Training Label
options.lineage: home training gear labels, bold movement instructions, and durable kit markings
options.thesis: Exercises read like clear equipment labels: big movement names, exact counts, and no motivational clutter.
options.case: Identifies strongly with training equipment, but its harder tone is less personal in a home setting.
options.viewport: A bold TODAY label anchors the next workout, with literal Week, Rounds, and Time fields and one orange Start tab within thumb reach.
options.risk: Heavy typography can feel aggressive if it overwhelms recovery, setup, and completion states.

canonCard.label: Simple Material home fitness
canonCard.thesis: A straightforward progress summary, next-workout card, week list, and guided exercise player.
canonCard.viewport: Progress sits above the next workout card, with predictable Plan and Library navigation.
canonCard.risk: Easy to learn, but least likely to feel newly imagined.
